GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES
NOTIFICATION
The 12th June, 2024
No.WR-IRWR04/37/2023-IW3/2057.- In exercise of the powers conferred by section
55 of the Northern India Canal and Drainage Act with Section 3 of the aforesaid Act, The Governor of
Punjab is pleased to notify the Khasra numbers as per details given below for smooth flow of water
in “Bahadur Singh Wala Drain RD 61093-291100”. The Governor of Punjab is further pleased to
authorize the Executive Engineer, Sangrur, Drainage-cum-Mining and Geology Division, WRD, Punjab,
District, Sangrur/Malerkotla, to take all necessary action to remove obstructions, in case obstructions
are raised by any person. The concerned officer i.e. Executive Engineer, Sangrur, Drainage-cum-
Mining and Geology Division, WRD, Punjab, District, Sangrur/Malerkotla, may also authorize any
other government officer or any private person to remove such obstructions or carry out any activities
for the aforesaid purpose.
